steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the RFQ event.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage rather than the default auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Create a line item whose requested quantity is 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the vendor named in the test case.
Publish the live RFQ for vendor bidding.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's live RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.

args.need: enter quantity 12 in Vendor A's bid sheet and submit the quote
